title: Songwriting Extension
intro: Use the 10 words or phrases collected while listening to “Triple C” to write an original school song with a partner. No separate sentence-writing task is required.

items.title: Plan together
items.text: Allow 3–5 minutes. Partners choose vocabulary words and agree on a theme or message about the school’s values.

items.title: Write a song
items.text: Allow 9–14 minutes. Partners create a short original verse and chorus using their chosen words.

items.title: Share
items.text: Allow 3–6 minutes. Invite volunteers to read or perform their song for the class.

source_note: Adapted from original Full Guide School Song teacher page (page 27), partner-song and sharing tasks; separate sentence-writing task omitted.
